connector.name: Brightdata MCP
connector.registryDescription: Bright Data's Web MCP server enabling AI agents to search, extract & navigate the web
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the brightdata account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BASE_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Max retries for base tools on transient errors (0-3, default: 0)
